notes.title: The full version is Now Released! 🥳
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Monuments Renovators! 🏛️[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]The long-awaited moment has just arrived and the game is available in its full version! 🥳[/b][/h3]

Our journey together lasted over a year through Early Access, during which time we received a lot of valuable information and feedback from you, which helped us direct the full version of Monuments Renovator. 😊

🔸 For players who decided to support us in Early Access, you don't have to do anything, you will only receive an update notification, which will give you the full version of the game.

🔸 For players who are joining us now, we have prepared several bundles with our partners, you can find the full list here -

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/666c79ebd030fcf190efb700f9db9cd68c901d46.png[/img]

[h3][b][u]The key differences that you can already see in the full version of the game are:[/u][/b][/h3][h3]1. Three new locations Great Wall, Luxor, Machu Picchu
2. Mini museum where we set the rewards obtained for completing the location
3. Tool repairs
4. Bug correction and optimization
5. GUI renewal[/h3]

Thank you once again for your contribution to the development of Monuments Renovator and we can only invite you to play the full version of the game!

[previewyoutube=RDpoDZz-Cwg;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://discord.gg/Gn6SpRueuK][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png[/img][/url]

Have fun!

notes.title: Get Ready for the Full Version! 🥳

notes.title: Retrospection
notes.content:
[h1][b]Dear Monument Flipper Community! 👋[/b][/h1]

It’s been a while since the release of the early access of our game. Today, with each step taking us closer and closer to the end of the Early Access phase and release of the full version 🗼 we’d like to take a small break from all the fixes, putting finishing touches and all the work we’re tirelessly doing every single day to assure the full version will be a satisfying experience to all of you. 🔨 

[h3]Today, we’d like to take a quick look at what we have achieved throughout Early Access thus far. We wonder how many of you were with us from the very beginning of EA and who followed our steps even longer. Let us know in the comments! 🙂 [/h3]

[h3][b]Three new maps [/b][/h3]
 
[b]The Great Wall of China[b], a truly monumental structure which dates back to a few centuries bc. A real challenge for those of you who don’t feel overwhelmed by the sheer size of this construction. 🧱

[b][Luxor Temple][/b], located under the scorching heat of the desert, this magnificent temple stands proudly, keeping the ancient secrets. A location not meant for people of weak nerves, wary of curses and mummies. ☠️

[b]Machu Picchu[/b], the most famous Inca city located over 2000m above sea level ⛰️, is also the best preserved one. Shrouded in mystery of the sudden disappearance of its inhabitants is a place full of valuable artifacts and knowledge about the Inca traditions.

[h3][b]Trophy room [/b][/h3]

A new room inside your office. A testament to your effort and achievements. 💪 Place where you can arrange and display all the gifts you’ve received throughout your journey on various occasions. Will you be able to fill in all the shelves? 

[h3][b]New mechanics and fixes [/b][/h3]

A tool deterioration mechanism for those of you who look for a more realistic experience and many fixes based on the feedback we’ve received from you. We’re really, really grateful for all the time spent together with you, every single discussion, opinion and tip. We’ve read them all and always appreciated and will appreciate your part in creating this game. 👏

Unfortunately that’s it for today but before we go we’d like to show you a short video and take you on a quick visual journey through the mentioned locations! 🗺️

[previewyoutube=8GZtfoshMxw;full][/previewyoutube]
[url=https://discord.gg/Gn6SpRueuK][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png[/img][/url] 

See you soon,
Monuments Filpper Team

notes.title: Tools Deterioration
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

We’d like to give you a quick update on the matter which has recently caused a bit of a fuss- the tools deterioration. We’ve heard your different opinions and stay assured, we’re working on making it as balanced as possible. 👍 

[b]We’d like to know if you’d like to have an option to switch this feature off, so please let us know in the comments! 💬[/b]

With that being said, we’ve added the durability indicators of your tools in the menu wheel. Repairing them will happen through completing a mini-game. The worse your attempt, the less durability will the repaired tool have. Hence, more frequent repairs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/a6b5e6f80097d2b86142148e53cec9edee6a1e60.png[/img]
We can’t wait to hear from you and share more things we’re currently working on next month. 🙂 In the meantime you can join our discord community 👇

[url=https://discord.gg/Gn6SpRueuK][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png[/img][/url]

See you soon,
Monuments Flipper Team

notes.title: Refreshed UI
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Flippers! 👋[/b][/h1]

The break from all this traveling around the world is a great time to tidy up. 🧹 Before the journey to Machu Picchu[b] we’ve decided to refresh and improve the UI[/b]. Alice herself- your favorite virtual guide was changed into a more cyber version. Let’s take a look, shall we?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/ade7f193fd52b88651d5713574a7b7d12b6258a6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/faf15c14bda616b3083dbcf20341f7e4d37f2c3e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/7fd4c238ea0eb5ae982c636354f3b2002bc3ffa2.jpg[/img]
[h3]Looks nicer, doesn’t it? Now back to Machu Picchu, [b]our crew found a real treasure while doing some minor tasks. 👷 Inca vases, ritual mask and even an image of the sun made of gold. [/b]☀️[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/93f7f701e72cd5f72979ef908e1463e54a2cbc1a.jpg[/img]
As you can see, those[b] beautiful anthropomorphic vases made of terracotta[/b] were waiting for us all that time. Preliminary inspection allowed us to assume they were made around the year 1400 and fortunately enough, the place they were buried conserved them perfectly. 

[h3]Now for the even more exciting part- [b]the Inca death mask[/b]. Those were made as the final gesture of respect to the deceased’s social status. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/268b6d64587480612a7cb0728310de9c7109b591.jpg[/img]
Unfortunately we can’t tell you the exact place we’ve found this mask to protect the place from scavengers. You’ll learn yourself soon enough. 🙂

By the way, [b]we may have found our alien[/b]! Beautiful statuette of a weird person with an empty stomach and a map of the stars on his back was discovered in the area. We’re extremely excited about this finding but that empty stomach does concern us… May there be a xenomorph in those ruins? 😨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/40158a941c95e1d79f1b4f5bf9447f9ac45dabc9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/98834e5317dbf07d8dea9b34b3c490230aa7c1bd.jpg[/img]
[b]We’d love to hear your opinions about the changes so make sure to join our discord 👇 and share them with us![/b] We’ll be back with more updates in the next devlog so look forward to it! 🤩

[url=https://discord.gg/Gn6SpRueuK][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png[/img][/url]

See you soon,
Monument Flipper Team

notes.title: Durability
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Flippers! 👋[/b][/h1]

We are happy to see you again in another Early Access devlog. 🙂 This one will be slightly similar to the previous one. Last time, we asked you to come home, take some rest and work on your trophy room. 📝 This time, we’d like you to take a look at your tools… Can’t you see? [b]Those faithful, good old tools that had your back on every single flip thus far… they’re almost completely broken[/b]. ⚒️ 

[h3][b]That’s unfortunate but inevitable with the extensive use throughout all the projects.[/b] That brings us to the core of changes this devlog introduces to the game- [b]the tools you use will break[/b]. 💥 It may not sound like a lot but with the sheer amount of work awaiting you… You’ll have to adjust your budget and take it into consideration. [/h3]

[b]Each usage of a tool will drop its durability by one[/b]. When its durability drops below a certain level, its icon in the wheel will become yellow, broken tools becoming red. 🚦 Those changes will also make difference in the actual use. [b]As their durability deteriorates, they’ll become less precise and progressively slower in use[/b]. Those durability markers will also appear on the objects. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/7da3d93d2ddab5a175c3e051d653d88df02bd5c5.jpg[/img]
By the way, we’ve discovered a sculpture dated 1400 years B.C. A young boy holding what resembles a pad in his hands who turned into stone delighted with his gameplay! 🎮 We wonder what title did he play…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/22c18e08b4827b3ed97dc82543084346024edfa7.jpg[/img]
Our office immediately picked up on this theory and started betting which game it was. 🤔 Could it be Monument Flipper: Stone Age? 

PS: our friends found something else beside the sculpture and they’re lucky it’s their last day there because what they found made their heart skip a beat. Luckily it was daytime… ⚰️ otherwise those mummies could’ve come to life! 😱

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/da9e7f22287c374a3fd0672ac956fea67af8d86c.jpg[/img]
[b]We can’t wait to hear your feedback about the changes we’ve presented today.[/b] Hopefully they’ll make the economical aspect matter more in the future but we’d love to know your opinions! 💬 Meet us on discord and share them with us, we await all of you there! 🔥

[url=https://discord.gg/Gn6SpRueuK][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png[/img][/url]

See you soon,
Monuments Flipper Team

notes.title: Display Room
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Flippers! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]It’s been a while since you’ve been able to come back home, to your favorite, cozy armchair, friends and what’s most important- relaxation. 🙂 [/h3]

Throughout the last couple of months, you’ve been in constant move, first the herculean task of saving [b]the Great Wall of China [/b]🧱, then the matter of the utmost importance- [b]the Luxor Temple [/b]🙏 and last but not least- restoration of the breathtaking [b]Machu Picchu [/b]☀️.

But finally, the time has come- there is no task ahead and you can get your well deserved rest. 😴 Throughout all those years of impeccable, relentless work your successful flips resonated with the hearts of people. After completing each of the tasks, you’ve been gifted souvenirs from all around the world. 🌍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/fa6ffe170dcb68da8b81089268e326082e0bdc16.jpg[/img]
[h3]You’ve even had a well-known construction company provide your office with an extra room where you could store and properly display all the beautiful gifts you’ve received. 👷[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/26b44714814980b253a41352729e568b1cd1c176.jpg[/img]
[h3]As you can see, there are still lots of boxes to unpack. But this room without the doubt is the testimony to all of the great deeds you’ve completed throughout your career! 👏[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/f9da33d76b5bebd82444bf89303f4c4d31e71ec8.jpg[/img]
That’s right- we’d like to introduce you to a new room in your office, where you’ll be able to store memorable objects found or gifted to you during your tasks! 👍 

We’d also like to show you a visual change in the gameplay. From now on, you’ll not see the hands, just the tools while you’re working. 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/5f4ce022ebb98d1e82355002a48da547d04eba6a.jpg[/img]
We hope the contents of this short devlog are to your liking and in the future, you’ll share with us your stunning collections! 🤩 [b]Don’t forget to join our discord [/b] where you can interact with us and other members of the community! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1257280/Monuments_Flipper/ 

[url=https://discord.gg/Gn6SpRueuK][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png[/img][/url] 

See you soon,
Monument Flipper Team

notes.title: New Structure!!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Flippers! 👷[/b][/h1]

[h2]Today, let us take you to the long forgotten past and tell you [b]the history of the next object[/b] [b]on your work list[/b]. [/h2]

[h3][b]III Century BC. Quilian Shan Mountain range, Sino-Mongolian boarder.[/b] 🌏 The First Emperor of China [b]Quin Shi Huang[/b] 👑 orders the building of a structure which will protect his empire and people from fierce attacks from the North. [b]A structure so monumental, so big that can be seen from space[/b]. 🛰️ His descendants continued his work and [b]completed the largest structure to ever exist[/b], ✔️one of the wonders of the world. Chinese people called it many names: [b]“The Earth Dragon”[/b], [b]“10 000 Li’s Wall”[/b] but we all know it as [b]the Great Wall of China[/b]. [b]Spreading across almost 21 200 km[/b]. 🤩[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/36fe84d98c93dc2854f0f72575d096dbabb5ecb7.jpg[/img]

For many centuries [b]the Wall was left unattended, slowly but surely eroding[/b] due to poor quality materials it was built of, as well as many atmospheric factors and changes in climate. 

[h3][b]New government of China decided to put an end to this neglect[/b] and here is where [b]YOU[/b] come in handy. Who’s more qualified to complete this task but the one who repaired the Notre Dame de Paris and many other legacy buildings? 👷[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/450c642c86c71bb5d3a36d3fb51d4fe8449dbbaa.jpg[/img]

[h3]The task is simple, yet demanding- [b]repair the collapsed fragments of wall[/b] 🧱as well as [b]the guard tower, clean the walls of the debris 🧹, find the artifacts of the past and display them in the rebuilt tower[/b]. When you are done, [b]light the bonfires 🔥 and fire the cannons [/b]💥 to find out how the warning system worked on this historical structure.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/ab7e7c5f57f0f48a29e99f20460ccbd5a182a3b0.jpg[/img]

[h2]Beware though, [b]you must hurry[/b] 🏃because there is an [b]invitation to Luxor pending[/b] as well as a [b]business card given to you by the conservator of Machu Picchu[/b]. 🤩[/h2]

[h3]Long story short, we present to you[b] the NEW STRUCTURE: Great Wall of China!![/b] 🤩. Because of it’s [b]tremendous size[/b], [b]we are still working on it[/b] but worry not, [b]waiting a bit longer will be worth it[/b]. 😍[/h3]

We [b]really appreciate your suggestions and comments[/b] about the game and it’s contents so [b]join our discord community[/b] 👇 and let us know which structures would you love to see in the game. 

[url=https://discord.gg/Gn6SpRueuK][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #23 - Elevator
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to the next Monuments Flipper devlog! [/h2]

While working on renovations in Monuments Flipper you will have the opportunity to not only work on small buildings but also the large ones with many floors and levels. We knew this from the very beginning of creating the game and we were always wondering about the best solution in this case. We decided that we wanted to give you something functional to save you some time - we didn't want to force you to spend too much time while going up the stairs if there is something to be done on a very high level. 

Today, we want to present the[b] elevator[/b]. Of course, the work is still in progress, so many things will change when it comes to the visual aspect of them, but we couldn't wait any longer to show you that new feature and we hope that you are as much excited as we are 😊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/d8ebfa03333d158bfd217e87780dcc5cd44a67fc.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #14 - Description of the objectives
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to the next Monuments Flipper devlog! [/h2]

If you haven't played our demo yet, it's time to do it - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1257280/Monuments_Flipper][b]PLAY NOW[/b][/url] 🏛️

Following our latest devlog that was published a week ago, we wanted to mention few more things about the visible information before actually, you will have a chance to start the renovation of the chosen building.

notes.title: Monuments Flipper | UPDATE AND FIXES
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

We would like to thank you a lot for your feedback and your interest in playing the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1257280/Monuments_Flipper/][b]DEMO[/b][/url] version of Monuments Flipper. If you haven't tried it out yet, you still have a chance to do it and share your feedback with us :) 

Thanks to your detailed reviews about your first impression of the demo, we are able to release a patch in order to help you improve your gameplay and fix all the issues that you've encountered. 

[b]The list of changes:[/b]
- Added game launcher
- Post-processing fixed: motion blur, bloom
- Invert, fixed
- An alternative way to rotate items has been added: now it can be done with the arrows on the keyboard, or the renovation table mode SHIFT + arrows
- Vsync fixed
- Added the ability to display FPS (R key by default)
- Collider on crates increased - tiles should no longer fall under them
- Fixed bugs with resolution and screen mode
- Fixed bugs when changing graphics settings
- Fixed bugs with opening the door
- Added a new option in the information about the location, renovation documents

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/3e65d784c083bfa26ef9d566026fec922b9a3ff5.png[/img]

The newest version with all the fixes you can download just now ;)
Once again, thank you so much for your feedback!

notes.title: Devlog #3 - Restoring elements
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everybody![/h2]

Welcome back to our Monuments Flipper devlogs! 
Today we would like to introduce another essential feature of our game. Last time, we were learning how to deal with the unwanted and destroyed environment. But what if we find something that may be used later? In this case, let's talk a bit about [b]restoring elements[/b]. 

When we find something that looks really promising, but we think that it needs a bit of polishing, here comes our special table. 😀 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/b26051d442f347349d9113b6eb0169976c783a53.png[/img]

After interacting with it, we can notice some very cool options such as "combine" and "renovation". Let's focus on the second one. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/3793c6bad81b577c1486d101dfcbaed710d5a104.png[/img]

Now we need to remember to select what we want to renovate - in this case, tiles. We just need to click on them so they will appear on your main screen. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/b5f6468f31b2f27ff8490f993334db43a1bb4100.png[/img]

Now it's time to open our inventory and decide what tool we would like to use (cloth). 😀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/f2948cab46966232c95d0aa26f07d4e5a0194133.png[/img]

Finally, by holding Left Mouse Button and moving the cursor over dirty areas, we can clean the tiles so we can use them later. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/cd11de13bf296a3babb843ffffc44e9eae438d7f.png[/img]

This is all for today. Are you ready for more? Stay tuned for more devlogs! And if you haven't played our demo yet, it's time to do it - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1257280/Monuments_Flipper/][b]PLAY NOW[/b][/url]

[url=https://discord.gg/cHCTwwvan9][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1257280/Monuments_Flipper/
